༄༅/ /rdo rje gtum po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i bsdus 'grel gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gtum po'i rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i bsdus 'grel gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs kyi padmo la gtugs te gus pa thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal lo// thos pa rgya mtsho ma bsgul zhing*// bsam pa mtha' yas ngal med par// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i gter 'byin pa'i// bla ma bde 'byung rgyan des skyongs// bde bar gshegs rnams bgro ba mdzad nas gsang gsum bdag por khyod bkong zil// srid pa'i dbang chen yongs kyis bzod dka' bka' nan phab pas bran du zhugs// 'phrog byed nga rgyal chen po slar khros zhabs kyis brdzis nas srog bral bas// nus pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i chen po phyag na rdo rje 'chang la bstod// rgyud rgyal tsan dan 'khri shing gi /lo ma thob pas phal cher log /rnam dpyod sta re bzang nged ni// snying po ma phyung bar ci la// 'dir dpal 'brug pa rdo rje 'chang rim par byon pa'i gsung ngag sgrub thabs skor lnga'i gya ba// rdo rje gtum po nus mthu'i skor gyi// rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po 'di bshad par bya ste/ bshad bya'i mtshan/ bshad tshul gleng gzhi/ bshad gzhung gtan la dbab pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wan badzra pā ṇi gu hya a bhi wā ngī tant+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa bshad tshul gleng gzhi ni/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa ldas ston te/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na dus phun sum tshogs pa/ ston pa ni bcom ldan 'das zhes pas te/ rgyud sde mang por/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ 'od dpag med la spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ mi bskyod pa la phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bzhag pa dang mthun par rgyud 'di'i ston pa ni phyi ma de yin la/ des byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje zhu ba por gyur pa dang*/

yang*/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*/ rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// zhes dgyes pa'i rdo rje las bshad pa ltar rnam par dpyad na zhu ba po yang ston pa de nyid/ chos kyang de nyid/ 'khor dang dus kyang de nyid du bzhag go /gnas ni lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ ri rab kyi rtse sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad la gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje 'chang ba lnga brgya rnams gnas par bshad pa/ ro ldan du grags pa de yin/ de'i nang gi byang shar gtso bo'i gnas su grags pa'i pho brang chen po'o// 'di yang rnam par dpyad na/ rdul gcig gi steng du rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing snang bar bshad pa'i 'og min dang tha mi dad pa'o// 'khor ni sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa'i tshogs dang*/ byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ rig pa'i khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang*/ lha ma srin gyi tshogs dang*/ gnod sbyin lnga brgya dang bcas te/ zhes pa/ chos ni phun sum tshogs pa bzhi 'dzoms pa de'i tshe rgyud 'di ston pa'i dus la bab pa yin pas/ ston pa bdud thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// gleng gzhi ngo ma ni 'di yin te/ bzhugs pa de'i mthus byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje 'khor gyi nang de nas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa la gzar nas phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to// kye ma gsang ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa ni gleng bslang ba'o// de ltar bskul ba'i ngor/ ston pa ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ thugs kar ye shes lnga mi phyed pa'i rdo rje lan gsum du gsor ro// de gsor bas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad 'gul ba dang*/ ldeg pa dang g.yo ba la sogs/ ltas chen po bco brgyad kyis kun tu 'khrugs te/ gdug pa can klu 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye nas slar thugs kar thim pa las/

rdo rje de'i lte ba nas yum dpa' mo rdo rje bde ma phyung*/ des ston pa la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ phyag byas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces zhus so// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ni/ gsang ba dam pa gang yin pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pas legs par gsungs/ 'di ni rnyed dka'i rgyud chen te/ rin chen lta bur 'dod 'byung ba/ grangs med tshogs las byung ba 'di/ thugs rje'i rang bzhin stong pa las/ bcom ldan khyod kyis bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ byams pa rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par byas nas/ tshur 'dus nas rang gi zhal du thim pa dang*/ dpa' mo rdo rje bde ma khyod// stong pa'i rang bzhin bdag med ma// ji ltar zhus bzhin bshad par bya// gus pas nyon la legs par zungs// zhes zhal gyis bzhes so// 'dir zhu ba dang po/ thabs kyi gdul bya'i dbang du byas la/ de tsam gyis kyang rnal 'byor rgyud du bzhag pa dang*/ zhu ba phyi ma shes rab kyi 'khor 'dul phyir du ste/ des bla na med pa'i rgyud du bzhag pas/ don la rgyud thams cad thabs shes gnyis su med pa yin pa ltar ston pa zhes pa'o// sngon byung gi gleng gzhi 'dis/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis mngon par rtogs pa slong ba'i tshul bshad de/ dang por ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ bsnyen pa/ de nas/ de las bzhengs te thugs kar rdo rje lan gsum gsor bas 'jig rten gyi khams 'khrugs par mdzad pa sgrub pa ste/ lus lha'i rtsal/ ngag nus pa'i/ yid ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'byin pa zhes bya'o// de nas gdug pa can klu 'dul ba'i 'od zer spros bsdu ba ni tshar bcad pa dang rjes su 'dzin pa'i las la sbyor ba/ slar zhal nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mdzad pa/ bsam gtan tsam gyis ji skad bshad pa ma grub na/ gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas nas bsgrub par ston pa yin no// gsum pa bshad gzhung gtan la dbab pa la/

bshad bya nges pa'i phyir mdor bsdus/ bshad pa nyid kyi tshig don/ bshad zin mjug don bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ dri bar/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ni// gsang ba dam pa gang yin pa// zhes dris pas/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs// mi phyed stong pa'i rang bzhin las// theg chen sna tshogs thabs tshul te// 'di ni rab tu rtogs dka' bas// 'das dang da ltar bzhugs pa dang*// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas spyod yul yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par dag /brjod med mi g.yo 'dus ma byas// nam mkha' dri med chos kyi sku// dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i mchog /'di la ji ltar bstan du yod// gsang ba de ches zab pas sangs rgyas nang phan tshun las gzhan gyi yul ma yin par bstan/ 'on kyang de yi rang bzhin las// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin ni// gnyis med gnyis kyi thabs tshul rig /'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste// de nyid gzhan la mngon bstan pa// gdul bya tshim 'gyur rgyal po bzhin// rang 'dod 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur bas// gsang ba mngon par bstan pa yi// rgyud chen rgyal po bshad par bya// sangs rgyas nang las gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin zhes bzhag na// gdul bya rnams thabs dang bral ba'i phyir 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur bas/ de la sbyor ba'i thabs bshad pas de rtogs par 'gyur/ rtogs na 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa ste/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po thob pa zhes bya'o// de'i phyir thabs la mkhas pas gsang ba de mngon par bstan par yang nus pa des rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal por song ba yin pas mtshan gsang ba mngon par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dang*/ de yang brjod byas rnam par gzhag go /bshad bya'i gsang ba de la rnam par dbye ba med par ni bshad na/ 'dir dri ba dang lan du sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zhes rnam par phye ba 'gal ba nyid du mi 'gyur grang snyam na/ 'gal med du dpes bsgrubs pa/

e ma ho/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// sna tshogs nor bu'i zhes gsungs te/ dri ma med pa'i shel gong*/ dar kha dog so so'i steng du bzhag na de dang de'i rnam pa 'dzin la so sor gzung kyang shel 'gyur ba med pa lta bu/ gsang ba de rang mi 'gyur ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo thams cad du mngon par bstan pa'i 'gyur ba 'di yang rung bas/ rgyud chen 'di/ rang gi gsang ba chen po yin/ hril dril na/ gsang ba ni chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid do// mngon par bstan pa ni chos can thams cad pa ste snga ma mdo phyi ma rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig bshad bya'i chos 'di ka e ma ho/ mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag ste/ chos kyang nga zhes bya ba'i don no// le'u dang po rdzogs so/// / gnyis pa bshad pa nyid kyi tshig don la/ gang gis bsgrub pa'i gdul bya gang du sgrub pa'i gnas// gang gis sgrub pa'i thabs/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu rnam par bzhag pa las/ dang po ni/ dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang khyod sgrub pa'i gang zag ji lta bu lags zhu ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sogs lan/ snying rje dang ni shes rab che nas yengs pa med kyi bar 'dis spyi'i mtshan nyid bstan la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang thob la zhes pa/ phyi bum pa nang gsang dbang*/ gsang bas gong ma gnyis legs par thob pa/ dam tshig brda don nges par 'dzin/ dgongs te bshad pa'i dam tshig bzhi 'dzin pa des na/ bsam gtan la gzhol ba dang*/ lhag pa'i lha la yid ches shing zhes pas bum dbang tsam thob pa/ sngags la gzhol pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin no// de ltas sgrub pa byas gyur na// yun mi ring bar rang nyid kyi// gsang gsum la ni mkhas gyur te// phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa snga ma'i dang*// 'bad pas thob pa'i 'bras bu ni// skal ldan de yi snying la gnas/ phyi mas thun mong gi dngos grub dang las rab 'byams 'grub par bstan pa'o// le'u gnyis pa'o/// /

gnyis pa gang du sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ zhu lan sngon du btang nas/ dur khrod brgyad dam nas/ shis zhes pa'i bar rung ba/ de nas mi bya'o zhes pa'i bar mi rung ba/ de yang gang zag sngags la gzhol ba'i dbang du yin la/ bsam gtan pa la ni/ smin pa'i gang zag de la ni// gnas sogs brtags pas ci zhig bya// thams cad bde chen sangs rgyas kyi// zhing khams rol pas gnas pa yin// dang*/ 'byed pa'ang*// de bas rigs kyi brtag par bya// zhes so// le'u gsum pa'o/// / gsum pa gang gis sgrub pa'i thabs la/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ bsgrub pa chen po gsum las dang po ni zhu ba lan/ nga nyid bsgrub pa'i rim pa zhes pa/ bsnyen/ sgrub bsgrub chen gsum rim pa bzhin du bya ba bstan la// snying rje chen po sngon 'gro zhing gzhan gyi don la bslab par bya// sgrub pa'i thabs 'di theg pa chen po'i yang chen po yin pas 'di la 'jug pa la/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dgos par bstan/ nam mkhar rdo rje can dmigs la// sems can kun la snying rje bsgom gyi bar gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs/ spros bral gnyis 'dzin spangs pa yi// nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin gnyis su med// 'dis ye shes kyi tshogs la gnas pa/ 'di'i dus/ chos gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa sbyangs nas sems rang rig rang gsal du gnas pa lus pas/ de mtshon pa'i nā da tsam zhig la dmigs pa yin/ ma rtogs log pa'i sems can la/ sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba'i phyir// snying rje chen po bsgom par byas pas bzhag pa stong pa nyid de las zhi rkyang du ma bsdad par/ 'khor ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i nus pa longs te/ de hūm̐ du/ de phyag mtshan/ de las lha'i skur rdzogs pa/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ nas/ bskal pa'i me dpung nang na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bshad/ yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum pa/ lhar bcas/ gtum po rigs gsum/ skye sgo byin gyis brlab/

'dir skye sgo ni lus ngag yid kyi sgo la bzhag la/ de gsum byin gyis brlab/ gnas su khro bo yig 'bru bskyed ni/ 'phrin las kyi gnas lte ba yin par 'og nas bshad pas der 'phrin las kyi rdo rje gtum po bsgom pa'o// de yan chad kyis dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa bstan/ sprul pa dpag med nas cod pan bsam gyi bar 'dis ye shes sems dpa' bstim pa bstan/ de yis ting nge 'dzin 'byung ba zhes pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gsal gdab pa ste/ 'di la dmigs/ de'i rgyun la yengs pa med pa thob// des reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed/ de tsa na rnam shes la dbang du gyur pa yin/ dgug pa dang bsad pa sogs tshar gcod kyi las 'grub la/ bsam gtan thob ye shes la dbang du gyur nas dgug pa 'grol ba dang*/ bsad pa gso ba sogs dang*/ ji bzhin pa'i lha sprul nas gzhan tshar gcod pa dang rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis ka nus/ de 'od gsal du spyod nus na phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'grub bo/ gal te de tsam gyi sgrub par mi nus pa sngags la gzhol ba des/ cho ga gsum pa'i sems dpa' yis/ gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pa bsgom// sku lha'i dbyibs la dmigs lus byin gyis brlabs pa'i spro bsdus sku'i bzlas pa/ gsung sngags 'bru la dmigs/ ngag byin gyis brlabs pa'i spro bsdus gsung gi bzlas pa/ thugs phyag rgya la dmigs/ yid byin gyis brlabs pa'i spro bsdus thugs kyi bzlas pa/ bzlas brjod dmigs pa dang bcas pa des/ sgo gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa yi dam gyi lha mnyes pa la bar du gcod pa de sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pas/ rang 'dod pa'i lha dang mnyam par 'gyur ba yin no// yang na gsung gi yig 'brus mtshan// sku la dam tshig gi bzlas pa/ gsung la 'khyogs kyi/ thugs la khro bo'i bzlas pa spro na sbyar ro// 'phrin las thogs med rnal 'byor bzlas// 'phrin las kyi lha la dmigs nas gzungs bklags te/

'di dus 'phrin las bzhi ka'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bya'o// lha yang phur gcig ma/ sngags phur sngags dang po bzlas kyang rung zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo*// ye shes kyi bzlas pa ni/ 'di ni rnam dag rig pa ste// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung rdo rje// zhes pas dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa dang mthun par bsgom pa yin te/ dbyibs kyi hūm̐ bsgom bya/ sgra'i hūm̐ bzla bya/ don gyi hūm̐ la yang dag par 'jog pa'o// de'i 'bras bu/ rtag tu ma nyams 'bras bu ldan// sngar bshad thams cad 'grub pa yin// le'u bzhi pa'o/// / gnyis pa sgrub pa la// rigs thams cad pa dang*/ bye brag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sku'i gsang ba dkyil 'khor/ gsung gi gsang ba gsang sngags bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zhu ba dang lan/ phyi ma/ tshogs bsags/ bsrung 'khor/ rten gzhal yas khang*/ brten pa lha/ byin brlabs/ go cha/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ gzhug pa/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ phan yon bshad pa rim bzhin/ skad cig ma yi lhar bsam nas// nas/ sbyang gzhi sngags kyi phyi nang kun/ stong par byas te rang lus kyang*/ zhes pa'i bar gyis tshogs bsags/ dbang po'i gzhu 'dra sprin 'dzin gyi/ nas/ rim par brjod kyi bar bsrung 'khor/ 'khor lo rtsibs phyogs mtshams la brgyad// steng 'og gnyis te bcur byed// mu khyud so so bas steng nas bltas na rtsibs brgyad// g.yas nas bltas na rtsibs bzhi pa lta bu/ lte ba dang rtsibs sbubs can de'i nang du lha dgod/ rtsibs 'og ma'i lha phal cher zhabs gyen bstan/ dbu thur bstan du 'dod de// 'dir/ de ni 'og gi gdon gzir pa po yin pas zhal 'og tu phyogs par 'os/ des na dbu gtso bo la bstan par bsgom mo// snying rje yi nas/ rdzu 'phrul mchog gi bar gyis/ sngar byang sems kyis bzhag pa'i nus pa 'dir rnam par smin pa bstan pa'i phyir bshad pa yin te/ ji ltar na/ yaṃ las 'byung ba gzhu 'dra ba nas/

ba dan ldan par bsam gyi bar rten gzhal yas khang*// 'di la gzhan bzhin rdo rje'i rwa bcu gnyis mi mngon te/ 'byung bzhi 'khor los khebs pas so// 'khor lo'i lte bar gzhal yas khang*// rtsibs gzhan gyi bad rwa lta bur song ba'i phyir dur khrod rdo rje rwa ba dang 'od kyi 'phreng ba blta'o// de nang baṃ las chu skyes ni/ nas/ gnyis med g.yon gyi phyogs nas 'khril gyi bar gtso bo mngon par byang chub pa lngas bskyed pa/ de rjes sbyor ba'i sgras bskul te nas/ sgo mtshams lha yi rang bzhin la zhes pa'i bar gyis 'khor mngal nas 'byin tshul/ mtshams dang sgo'i lha 'dir mi gsal ba 'og nas bshad pas 'dir rigs thams cad 'dus pa dang*/ de yang*/ lha bcu gsum mar ches gsal ba yin no// lus ngag sems la yi ge yis// spro bsdus lha yi mtshan ma gdab par bya/ lus ngag yid sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab pa bstan lha'i dbyibs bsgom pa ma bshad/ skye mched lhar byas nang gi skye mched drug la/ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba sogs 'god pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ nus pa mi shigs lhar bltas la/ yan lag rnams la khro bo/ ye shes lnga lus gnas lngar khrag 'thung rigs lnga/ ji ltar yab la yab rnams 'god pa bzhin yum la yum rnams bkod pas thams cad zhal sbyor du gyur te/ las kyi rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rgyas par/ khro bo kha sbyar lus byin brlabs/ zhes 'byung ngo*// de ni go cha'o/ ye shes spyan drangs mchod la gzhug de ni yi ge bzhi sbyor yin/ yi ge bzhi dgug pa dzaḥ gzhug pa hūm̐/ baṃ hoḥ phyi ma gnyis kyis zhugs zin pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bya ba yin no// yi ge bsam nas/ phyag rgya che la rigs med do'i bar gyi dbang bstan la/ sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi zhes pa/ 'dod na sems dpa' gsum phrugs su bya ba'ang bshad de nas phra mo bsgom/ de yang*/ rags pa mngon sum du ma byas par bsgoms kyang 'ol spyir zad pas bul chung ngo*// phan yon ni/

rim gyis gsal zhing rnam par dag /bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi mdor bsdu na/ tha mal/ snang*/ zhen gsum yin pas/ lha dkyil 'khor nga rgyal brtan pa gsum gyis de sbyang pa'o// de ltar sbyangs pas thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyis sprul pa'i spros pa 'di thams cad spros pa med par zhi zhing*/ de las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'am/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'am sna tshogs gzugs su grags pa thob par/ tshe gcig nyid la 'gyur ba yin/ de ltar mnyam bzhag brtan por song nas rjes snang grags rig gsum la lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum sbyar te bsgoms pas rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ sa sogs te sa bla sa steng sa 'og gi 'jig rten ma lus pa skad cig nyid la dbang du 'gyur te rang snang dag pas gzhan snang shul du mi las des snang ba thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su 'char ro// gnas skabs kyi dgos pa/ lus lha'i byin dang ldan pas/ gtsug na rin chen la sogs pa/ gdug pa can rnams snying yang 'byin/ ha cang mi bsrun pa 'dul dka' bas tshar gcod pa dbang phyug chen po lta bu/ dga' bo la sogs klu chen rnams/ rtag tu de la 'dud par 'gyur te 'dul sla ba bka' nyan du 'gyur ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa la sogs lta bu/ nad kyi rigs kun ma lus 'joms// gnod sbyin ma lus bka' nyan zhing*// lha srin ma lus bran du 'gyur// 'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste// mdzes ma khyod la bshad pa yin// le'u lnga pa'o/// / gnyis pa gsung gi gsang ba gsang sngags bstan pa ni/ zhu lan/ der nges tshig byed las/ btu ba'i gzhi/ btu ba/ ngo bo/ dbye ba de rin thang che bas dkon par bstan pas bshad pa rim pa bzhin/ gsang ba mchog gi gsang ba ste// des gsang sngags so// byed pa'i las/ 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs byed cing*/ sdug bsngal kun las skyob byed pa/ btu ba'i gzhi/ ā li kā li dbyangs dang gsal byed akṣa ras sam/

byañdza nas sam/ warṇas yi ger bzhag pa dag go /btu ba/ mnyam sbyor bas/ ngo bo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i sngags kyi don/ dbye ba rnam pa lnga ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa dang gcig 'phrin las sna tshogs rig pa dang gnyis/ 'khor gyi las kyi rig pa dang gsum/ 'byung po dgug dang bsad pa dang bzhi/ gtor ma btang ba'i rig pa'o// so sor ngos 'dzin na/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sku'i sngags/ oṃ badzra kro dha nī laṃ gsung gi sngags/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa thugs/ tadya thā bho bho gzungs/ 'phrin las/ oṃ badzra trai sogs 'khor/ ka ka rakṣa sogs 'byung po dgug bsad/ a kā ro sogs gtor sngags so// dgug bsad la/ ka ka rakṣa hūm̐ sogs gdon dgug ka ka rakṣas ma sogs lha dang 'brel ba/ hūm̐ hri la sogs spyi dril rbad bsad/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs snyan gsan/ budhā a sogs spyan 'dren/ badzra ghe ne sogs bskul/ kha dza rā dza sogs las 'gyed/ dzu dzu sogs bstab par bshad do// 'di ni rin chen lta bu ste// ma lus dgos 'dod 'byung ba yi// gzungs ma khyod la nyer bshad pa/ 'di ni mi 'di'i dam tshig yin// gsang 'dus las/ ma na yid ces bya ba ste/ tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa nyid/ ces 'byung ba/ lha dang sngags gnyis su mi phyed pa'i gnad bshad pa'o// le'u drug pa'o/// / gnyis pa bye brag pa bshad pa la/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi khro bo/ rigs kyi pho nya'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa gsum las/ dang po la/ dkyil 'khor tshad med pa dang*// zhus pa'i ngor tshad can gnyis su gsungs pa'i dang po/ nga yi 'khor ni bsam mi khyab// 'di tsam grangs ni sangs rgyas kyis// bskal par bgrangs kyang shes mi 'gyur// de bas nam mkha'i tshad dang mtshungs// de yang gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te/ bsam gyis mi khyab de 'dul ba// rigs la brjod par ga la nus/ zhes so// gnyis pa la rigs so so spyir bshad pa dang*/

rigs bsdus pa'i 'khor dmigs bsal du bstan pa'o// dang po/ mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya// sku yi 'khor ni khro bo bcu/ rigs lnga'i ngo bo zhes pas phyag rdor rigs lnga la khro bcus bskor ba zhig bshad/ de ni sku'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung gi 'khor ni dpag med pa// 'dis khyung nyi shu rtsa gcig pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ des mtshon te/ khyung brgyad pa/ khyung lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor bshad// de ni gsung dkyil/ thugs kyi 'khor ni rigs brgya ste/ dam pa rigs brgyas bskor ba zhig bshad de/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs pa yang*/ gdul bya'i dbang gis te/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje sogs// lnga brgya rigs bsdus sku yis 'dul// gdul bya'i 'khor ni klu chen brgyad// gsung gis de rigs 'dul ba yin// thugs kyi lha srin gdug pa can/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dul// de ltar gdul bya 'dul byed kyang*// 'di la 'di sprul sprul pa'i tshogs// smon lam dbang gis byung ba ste/ gnyis pa rigs bsdus kyi 'khor dmigs bsal du bstan pa ni/ rigs so so ba'i sku'i de ma thag gi sku gsung thugs/ mi 'gyur gdug pa 'dul ba yin// sku 'jigs byed/ gsung rta mchog thugs stobs ldan/ 'phrin las phur pa/ gsung gi rigs bzhi 'dul ba'i khyung chen yin// klu rigs bzhi 'dul ba'i khyung bzhi/ thugs kyi/ mdor bsdus sprul pa'i khro bo bzhi// khyad par gyi 'khor bzhir bsdus nas/ de dkyil 'khor la 'god pa ni/ thugs gsung sku'i rim pas snying po dang grwa dang sgo bar 'god des bcu gsum ma 'di rigs thams cad pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ste/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa'o// le'u bdun pa'o/// / gnyis pa rigs kyi khro bo bshad pa la/ khyung zil gnon dang*/ rdo rje phur bu gnyis/ dang po/ zhu ba dang lan gyi/ rdo rje gtum po nyid bdag bskyed du byas/

mdun bskyed du khyung bskyed nas las bsgrub pa 'dis/ rdo rje gtum po khyung gi sham bu can zhes grags so// de yang*/ gdug pa klu rnams 'dul 'dod pa nas/ 'og min gnas su sleb par bsam gyi bar gyis bskyed pa sku/ rdo rje gnas gsum yi ges brgyan/ nas/ yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab bsam gyi bar byin brlab dang go cha/ de nas gsang ba'i sngags bstan pa/ sogs las kyi rdo rje 'di gsum ka bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor la phur bu gnyis pa'i drag sngags kho na bzhed pa yin/ mthun pa'i rdzas kyi gtor ma sbyin/ bzlas brjod rdzogs nas gtor ma dbul ba yan nye ba'i bsnyen pa/ de'i nang du gnod pa dgug nas sgrub pa dang las la sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa rdo rje phur bu ni/ gal te bsad par 'dod pa na// sku gsung thugs kyi/ zhes pas/ bsnyen pa ste/ rnal 'byor lnga ldan/ de yang*/ bskyed pa lha'i rnal 'byor/ bzla pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ bsgom pa bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor/ gsum mnyam bzhag zas dang spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rjes su byas pa'o// rig pa la/ phur bu gnyis pa'i drag sngags dang*/ zhes pas bsnyen pa la rtags thon nas sgrub pa la 'jug la/ 'di las tshogs phyug pas rje btsun ras chung pa gdams ngag zab shos su mdzad ces grags so// rig pa'ang las kyi sbyor ka chen po drug tu bstan te/ bsrung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ bsreg pa dang*/ 'phang ba dang*/ mnan gtad do// bsrung ba bris pa lha lda ma dang bcu bdun mchog bsgom pa khro bo bcu pa'am rdo rje'i rwa gur tsam/ bzlog pa log tri pā la la mdzad/ bsad pa la/ sdon 'gro/ sgrub pa'i khyad par brgyad de/ dus dang*/ dal dang*/ ling ga dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ thun rdzas dang*/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ 'phrul 'khor drug ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin/ sgrub pa rang gi dngos gzhi/ mdun gyi 'gying gtor la bskyed chog gtor 'bul gyi bar byas nas/

'brub khung gi nya'u bskyed/ sdig pa bgo bden brdar dang*/ bskul phyag rgya las la dgye nas dgug sdig pa bsgrag rgyab rten dang phral/ gzugs brnyan phur bus gdab par bya/ man gyis kha sbyar dbye/ thun brab pa rtags ma thon gyi bar du'o// rtags thon nas ling ga de mtshon gyis gtubs/ de rjes gzugs brnyan ma lus pa/ nas/ rdzogs pa'i bar gyis bsreg 'phang mnan pa las kyi mjug sdud du mdzad/ 'di dgra la bya ba dang*/ klus bzung ba'i klu gdon la bya ba yin la/ phur bu gnyis pa zhes pa/ lha phur zhabs phyag mtshan yang phur bu 'dzin pa gnyis pa'o// le'u brgyad pa'o/// / gsum pa rigs kyi pho nya ni/ zhu lan gyi/ nga yi gnod sbyin bdag po 'di/ zhes pas ngos gzung*/ bya ba'i las kun thogs pa med/ khyad par drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub/ ces de'i nus pa bstan/ de yang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyis bshad pa'i dang po/ dur khrod brag rdzong nags phug dang*/ nas rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin bsgrub// kyi bar gyis bskyed chog de yi rig pa phul ba ni/ oṃ sogs kyis bzla bya sngags/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor gang dmigs la nas 'brel bar 'gyur gyi bar/ khyi nag snying du gnod sbyin gyis/ nas/ de yis gtong bar mi byed do'i bar gyis de lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor ba'i rten bca' ba bstan no// le'u dgu pa'o/// / gsum pa bsgrub pa chen po bshad pa la/ thugs kyi gsang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ de thams cad dbang thob nas bya ba yin pas dbang bskur bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyas pa rnal 'byor lnga pa/ 'bring po rten med/ rten can/ bsdus pa dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa gsum ste/ dang po/ rags pa'i rnal 'byor/ phra mo'i/ thig le'i/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ zhu lan gyi/ bsam gyis mi khyab rdzogs pa che/ nas/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar yang*/ gi bar dang po/ padma dmar po 'dab bzhi la/

thig le sngon po rgya sran tsam/ phra mo de dbus nyi zla gzhal yas khang gi bar thig le/ ci yang mi bsam sogs bsam mi khyab gsal la mi rtog man gyis rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ rten med kyis dran pa'i rtsi btang ba/ rten can gyis shes bzhin gyis rtsal sbyong ba gnyis don zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor/ dang po/ rten med rnam dag bsal ba yin/ yang dag pa'i dran pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas su byon pa'i gzhung lam yin pas de brten pa'o// rtog pa ni so sor rtog pas rtog pa ste/ gang la brten nas so sor rtog na rten can bsgom 'dod pas zhes gsungs la/ de yang steng gi sgo bkag nas stong pa bde ba la sbyor ba/ 'og gi 'dzag pa bskyil nas bde ba stong pa dang sbyor ba/ gnad 'byed pa'i sgo dbye nas nam mkha' rdo rje'i grong la 'jug pa'o// dang po la/ rtsa yon po byed bcings kyis bsrang ba/ rlung log pa rang gnas su 'gugs pa/ khams zhu ba dwangs mar sbyang ba gsum/ dang po/ de dbus gnyis ming ces pas dbu ma/ g.yas dang g.yon/ thabs dang shes rab rnam par dbye/ zhes pas ro rkyang*// sku'i gnas su 'khor lo ni/ nas/ shes rab gnyis 'gyur kha dog dmar/ gyi bar gyis 'khor lo bzhi/ rtog pa sad pa'i 'khor lo ni/ thabs la drug dang*/ zhes pa gtsug tor/ shes rab drug tha ma bde ba 'dzin pa'i sa zhes bya bas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo bshad pa yin la/ gnyis pa/ yi ge bzhi yis brgyan mdzad de/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par byed pas ro rkyang nas kha phyir bltas pa glog ste rang gnas dbu mar gzhug par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ rtogs pa sad pa ni sgra rtogs las 'das pa'i mi rtog pa chen po yin pas/ mi rtog dpa' bo gnas pa yin/ 'khor lo der haṃ/ bde 'dzin 'khor lo yi ge med/ da lta shad yin pas/ brjod pa thams cad spangs pa ste/ zhes gsungs don pa lu ta/ de 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'o// dgos pa/

khu ba khrag dang chu ser gnas// 'dis ni lam gsum 'joms byed pa'o// 'bar 'dzag gis khams thams cad dwangs mar byas pas 'dzag pa med pa'i sku 'grub pa'o// skad cig rlung gi rta yis ni/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis bskul nas/ gnyis med ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ ni phyag rgya ma la brten pa ste/ bsam mi khyab tu/ nyi zla gza' yis zin pa na/ shes rab rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis// bzhu ba gnyis med ye shes 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa/ gsum pa/ ye shes kyis ni rtog pa bsreg thal ba'ang dmigs par mi 'gyur bas/ gnad kyi sgo 'byed pa'i tshul/ rtags lnga rim pas 'byung bar 'gyur/ rags pa dang*/ snang ba gsum thim nas/ lnga par 'od gsal 'byung ba/ 'od gsal de mngon du byas pa/ tshogs las grub pa'i ye shes yin/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu mthong ba'i lam/ yang dang yang du bsgom par bya/ sde pa bzhi yis longs spyod ni/ mas brtan pa'i 'khor lo bzhir bgrod pas dga' ba bzhi skye ba/ gnas gsum ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi thig le dag pa mngon du byas pa/ gnyis med bde ba'i gnas thob nas skye 'chi la sogs rgyun chad de/ ye shes kyi thig le rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi sar sleb pas/ 'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i gnas/ thob par 'gyur pa smos ci dgos/ nas/ bshad pa yin gyi bar gyis so// gsum pa ni/ dpa' bo brtan par ma gyur na/ bskyed rim bzlas brjod dang bcas pas sems brtan par ma gyur na/ yi ge hūm̐ gi sbyor ba yis/ 'di/ mngon du bya ba gzhi'i hūm̐/ mngon du byed pa thabs lam gyi hūm̐/ mngon du byas pa 'bras bu'i hūm̐ gsum/ gnyis pa sbyong byed dbyibs kyi hūm̐ ste/ 'jig rten khams kun 'jig par 'gyur// brjod pa sngags kyi hūm̐ bzlas pa ste/ me ni bud shing bsreg mdzad de/ shing med me yang ji ltar gnas// mnyam par bzhag bya don gyi haṃ la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/

brtan g.yo mnyam par gyur pa na// de gcod byed rig pa'i hūm̐ du langs pas/ mi shigs yi ge rnam par dag de brdal ba chen po'i hūm̐ du rdzogs pa/ 'di ni nga yi gsang ba ste// gsang ba bla na med pa 'di// bdag med rtogs pa khyod la bshad// rdzogs pa'i rim pa gsum po de yang mdo tsam ste/ rgyas par/ gzhan du gaṅgā'i bye ma dang*/ mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*// brjod par nus pa ga la yod/ ces gsungs so// le'u bcu pa'o/// / gnyis pa de thams cad dbang thob nas bya ba yin pas/ dbang bskur bshad pa la dpon slob kyi rten 'brel/ dkyil 'khor gyi las rim/ dbang bskur bshad pa gsum/ dang po/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid sngar bshad la/ des bla ma legs par brtags nas bsten par bya ste/ dngos grub thams cad de'i rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir de bshad pa/ dang por slob dpon mtshan nyid kyang*/ sogs kyis dbang gi don du de la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar dngos su gsungs la/ des zhal gyis bzhes bsnyen pa kha skong bya ba shugs kyis bstan no// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las rim gsang ba spyi rgyud dang mthun par bshad/ der/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi gzung*/ gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya/ nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shes/ zhes pa ltar/ nub dang po sa chog de yang brtag pa phyogs dang lto 'phye dang ro bsal pra brtag pa rnams/ grong dang sogs kyis bstan la/ laṃ las byung ba'i sogs nas bslang sbyangs zhes pa'i bar gyis bslang sbyangs gzung ba bstan no// sta gon lha bum slob ma'i sta gon gsum ste/ bsrung zhing gtso bo la sogs kyis lha/ rin po che'am sa yang rung sogs kyis bum pa/ 'og gi gus pas me tog dang bcas nas/ zhi ba'i me yis bzlog par bya ba'i bar gyis slob ma'i bstan la/ slob ma rnams la rjes brtse bas/ sdom gzung gsol zhing bsrung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor bkod nas zhes pa 'di ni zla ba dang lo la sogs pas dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dbang du mdzad pas// dbang thob nas de lta bu'i don du 'du ba'i slob ma la'o// nub gsum pa la dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba bshad la/

dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas skabs su bab pa la dbang bskur kyang legs pa yin no// de bas na 'dir nub gsum pa rang gi cho ga la/ thig dang*/ tshon dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa las/ dang po/ srad bu ye shes lnga ldan pa/ sogs dang*/ gnyis pa/ rin chen lnga'am 'bru yi phye/ sogs dang*/ gsum pa/ de nas rdo rje'i 'chang dmigs la/ zhes pas bdag mdun gnyis kar bshad do// dbang bskur bshad pa la/ sngon du bdag 'jug de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dang po/ slob dpon smin nas slob ma rnams/ phung po lnga po dag par sbyangs// zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa la dbang bskur thob pa med pas/ sngon du 'jug pa/ phyis dbang bskur ba/ dang po/ gdong g.yogs bcings la ye shes dbab// ces pas mdor bstan/ dkyil 'khor dam par gzhug pa'i phyir/ nas/ rigs kyi de la spro bar bya ba'i bar/ dbang bskur ba ni/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*// shes rab ye shes chen po'o// dang po la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/ dang po ni/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*/ dril bu ming gi dbang bskur ro// zhes pa rigs lnga'i bdag nyid ye shes lnga ste/ dngos gzhi de yin la/ de tsam gyis sngags kyi sgrub pa por rung bas de'i dbang du byas nas de'i mthar/ brtul zhugs lung bstan rjes gnang sbyin/ dbugs dbyung*/ gal te slob dpon du 'os pa zhig na/ rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub ces pas/ brtul zhugs la sogs pa de'i mtha' brten du bya ba ste/ de ni drug gi bye brag dbang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i rig pa de bskur ro// de ni rdo rje sems dpa'am rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bdag nyid/ stong nyid snying rje gnyis zung 'jug gi ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin no// gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa brjod med dbang bskur ba/ zhes pa gong ma gsum rim pa bzhin bstan la/

bzhi pa tshig dbang zhes pa dang*/ 'dir brjod du med par bshad pa mi 'gal lam zhe na/ dbang de sgra rtog gi yul las 'gongs pa zhig yin pa/ gsum pa dper byas nas de'i dus su thabs kyis mtshon bya mngon sum du 'gyur ba la sgros btags/ tshig gis phyis brda sprod pas de tsam gyis tshig dbang du bzhag pas 'gal bar mi 'gyur/ gsang ba mchog gi sogs dbugs dbyung dang*// dam tshig bsgrag gzung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa ltar/ sogs kyis yon 'bul dang rjes su bya ba'i rim pa'o// le'u bcu gcig pa'o/// / de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu rnam par gzhag pa la/ nus pa dang ldan na klu nad 'byin pa/ las thams cad la gtor ma gces pas de bstan pa/ de dag rigs kyi yum gyi rnal 'byor gyis kyang 'grub pa/ 'dod na las rab 'byams la sbyor ba'i tshul bshad pa bzhi'i dang po la/ sa bdag klu'i gdon dgrol// nad zhugs pa'i rtags/ 'don pa'i thabs bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ zhu lan gyi/ gdul bya'i rigs su gnas pa ni// gdug pa'i klu chen rnam pa brgyad// rigs bsdus chu bdag ba ru ṇa// dam tshig la gnas sog ma med// 'di dag sgrub par 'dod pas na/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgrub pa'ang nad 'byin pa'i las sbyor gyi sngon gyi sgrub pa la dgongs so// ji ltar bsgrub pa'i bcas mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ mchod rdzas klu yi rtsi sman bsham// bdag bskyed/ de rjes rdo rje 'dzin bsams la// bdag mdun gnyis ka'i gtso bo yin// mdun bskyed la de la 'khor du/ padma'i lte bar chu bdag dang*/ dam tshig sog med dkar dang ser/ thal sbyar sbrul gyi zhabs su 'khyil/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// 'di gnyis lte ba'i gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon/ shar phyogs dga' bo sngon po ste/ nas/ sa bdag sna tshogs gzugs kyis bskor/ gyis bskyed/ klu chen gnas nas spyan drangs te/ e hye hi nas/ bzhugs par gyur bar gyis dgug pa/

oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sogs rdo rje 'chang gi klu dam la bzhag pa dran par byed pa/ nā ga rā dza sogs kyis dam tshig 'dzin pa/ rim pas mchod cing sogs kyis mchod bstod sngags bzlas/ gzhan yang 'jig rten pa rnams la sogs kyis bya ba cho ga bya ste/ zin nas gnod pa'i phyogs su bskyal ba/ bsrung 'khor gdags pa/ de bzhin byas na klu nad rnams sogs kyis phan yon/ le'u bcu gnyis pa'o/// / gnyis pa nad zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ zhu lan gyi/ klu la rigs drug la sogs pa/ sna tshogs rigs su yod gyur kyang*// 'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin te// 'dir rigs lngar bshad kyang lnga pa thams cad la khyab byed yin pas don la bzhir bsdus so// bzhi yang*/ nor rgyas dung skyong rgyal rigs yin te mthong ba'i dug /ser po sa la dbang ste zhes pas dug ngos gzung*/ lci 'thibs lus po sbom sogs nad rtags/ dga' bo rigs ldan bram ze yin te bsam pa'i dug /dmar po me la dbang ste dang*/ tsha zhing gdung ba sogs/ nad rtags/ padma 'jog po rje rigs yin te kha rlangs dug /dkar po chu la dbang bas dang*// grang zhing bsil ba sogs nad rtags// pad chen stobs rgyu dmangs rigs yin te reg pa'i dug /nag po rlung la dbang bas dang*// yang zhing g.yo ba sogs nad rtags zhar la rgyu dus dang bcas pa bstan/ chu lha dam tshig /nam mkha' yin te kun la khyab/ ces pas/ de kho nas zin pa med de/ nam mkha' thams cad la khyab kyang las 'byung ba bzhis byed pa yin no// thun mong gi rtags spyir na lnga ka gang zhugs kyang*/ sogs kyis so// le'u bcu gsum pa'o/// / gsum pa 'don pa'i thabs bshad pa ni/ zhu lan gyi/ byol song klu yis zin pa sogs kyis 'tsho mi 'tsho brtags te/ 'tsho ba la thabs bya bar bstan/ gso tshul la/ dang po sngags kyi rim pa ste// nus pa chung ba bsnyen pas/ 'bring bsad pas/ shin tu tshabs che ba klu rang gshed du dbab pa'i sgo nas so// 'phrul 'khor tshar nas ma bde na// rgyal po bsdong zla dbye bar bya// sde brgyad kyi gtad phyung rgyab dang 'brel ba'o// gnyis pa rdzas kyis gso ba ni// gnyen po mi mthun rdzas dang sbyar// sman gyis bsdu bsad sbyang gsum bsten pa'o// rtags log na sbyin sreg gis phyir rjes bcad par bya'o// le'u bcu bzhi pa'o/// /

gnyis pa las thams cad la gtor ma gces pas de bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bri dang sogs kyis gtong tshul sgrub pa bzhi ldan du ste/ bsgrub pa bzhi bdag bsgrub pa/ rdzas bsgrub pa/ mgron bsgrub pa/ las bsgrub pa'o// dang po/ lha yi rnal 'byor ldan pa yis// gnyis pa phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa bsag /nas/ gnyis med thabs dang shes rab yin// phyi ma 'dis gtor ma der gang gis 'jog pa'i mtshan nyid kyang bstan pa yin no// gsum pa sa bon las byung padma'i gdan/ nas bstod cing gi bar/ bzhi pa gsol ba gang yin bya sogs kyis rjes 'bras bu dang bcas pa bstan no// le'u bco lnga pa'o/// / gsum pa de rigs kyi yum gyi rnal 'byor gyis kyang 'grub par bstan pa ni/ zhu lan gyi/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i ma/ nas/ nga yis kyang ni 'dir bshad de/ zhes pas 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs tshul/ byang chub sems ldan gang zag gi /nas/ rus pa rin chen rgyan dang ldan gyi bar gyis bskyed chog /rtag tu ye shes pa yang mchod// de la ye shes spyan drangs mchod byas bstim pa/ zhar la lha dbang bskur ba yang bstan/ rig pa nges par bstan pa ni nas/ 'bum 'gyur sngags kyi 'brel par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar bzlas pa/ 'bum 'gyur zhes pa dus bzhir grangs 'gyur ba bstan te/ rdzogs ldan las rtsod pa'i dus 'gyur de bzhi 'gyur du bgrang dgos pas so// 'di nyid kyi khyad par gyi las mchog sgrub ces pa dngos grub yi dam gyis ster kyang byin gyis mkha' 'gro mas rlob pa yin pas/ 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir/ kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ zhes dgyes rdor las bshad pas so// gnas skabs/ nad rnams sbyang ba dang*// bsrung zhing 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ zhi rgyas dang rang gi srog 'dzin tshe/ 'phrin las dbang ste 'phrin las rgyas par byed pa'o// thun mong*/ las gzhan dngos grub ma lus par// lha mo khyod kyis byed pa yin/

de'i phyir/ 'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste/ zhes gsang bas mchog yin no// de bas mdzes ma khyod la bshad/ le'u bcu drug pa'o/// / bzhi pa 'dod na las rab 'byams la sbyor ba'i tshul la/ lha sngags ting 'dzin rdzas bzhi sbyor gyis 'grub pa/ lha'i stobs kyis 'grub pa/ spyin sreg gi cho gas 'grub pa/ bstod pas 'grub pa bzhi'i dang po// zhu lan gyi/ sgrub po phun sum tshogs 'dod pas/ rang nyid thog mar bsnyen byas te/ zhes pas/ las gang byed kyang bsnyen pa'i rtags thon pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ de nas 'dod pa'i rjes la 'khor lo bri sogs rang rang gi bcas byas bsgrub pa las la sbyar bas gdon mi zab bar 'bras bu 'byung ba yin la/ gong bu dgug pa longs spyod dgug pa yin/ rkang pas dgug pa srog ldan dgug pa yin la/ gzhan rnams gzhung tshig nyid kyis gsal bar thon no// le'u bcu bdun pa'o/// / lha'i stobs kyis 'grub pa ni/ zhu lan gyi/ chu bdag gnas pa'i sa yi char/ dbab pa'i gnas/ dkyil 'khor padma 'dab brgyad la sogs bcas// 'dab mar klu chen brgyad bskyed la// spyan drangs mchod pa byas nas kyang*// bar gyis cho ga char gyi rgyun chen po 'bebs par bsams nas 'bebs par 'gyur gyi bar gyis ting nge 'dzin bzlas sngags/ gal te babs par ma gyur na spogs pa'i cho ga rnams bcas pa bshad do// 'dir rigs kyi khro bo rtsa ba khyung zhal can zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa de'i byin klus mi bzod pas bsgom pa tsam gyis char 'bab par bshad pas 'di lha'i stobs su bzhag go /le'u bco brgyad pa'o/// / gsum pa sbyin sreg gi cho gas 'grub pa ni/ zhu lan gyi/ thabs dang rdzas dang lha dang ni// sngags kyi rim pa phan yon rnams// rim pas mdzes ma khyod la bstan/ gyis mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa la/ sbyang ba'i las ni sngon 'gro bas// dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang mthun par sa chog bya ba/ sor ni nyi shu bco brgyad dang*/

sogs kyis thab kyi chung tshad bshad la gzhan spyi dang mthun no// rim bzhin/ nad rnams zhi zhing nor 'phel dang*/ nas/ gsod pa'i thab tu shes par bya// de dag la'o// thur brko sor gsum gnyis kha khyer mtho/ rim bzhin phyed phyed rdo rjes mtshan/ mdog dkar ser dmar nag ljang khu ste/ las dang 'brel par shes par bya/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang yam shing dang*/ dūr ba la sogs bsreg pa'i rdzas so// 'god lugs/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi rim pa yis// bdag bskyed// rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed/ bsam pa rgyas la dga' dang sogs// phyogs dman pa me phyogs sogs/ 'jig rten pa'i lha/ hū ྃlas skyes pa'i kha dog dmar sogs bstim/ ye shes pa bstim pa/ de la mchod pa bsangs gtor sogs/ me pra/ de rjes me yi mtshan ma brtag sogs/ ngan na de las mi rigs bzlog /rdzas 'bul ba/ de rjes rdzas kyi rim pa ni sogs/ de nas bstod pa dang 'dod gsol/ bstod cing gsol ba'i las bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i sbyin sreg me yi snying gar dkyil 'khor mchod// bsang gtor la sogs rim pa bzhin sngar bstan pa las shes par bya/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin sreg de rjes lhag mas ci rigs mchod/ slar 'jig rten par/ gang du gang 'bul na/ khu ba la sogs rdzas rnams ni// lha'i zhal du sogs/ rjes cho ga dkyil 'khor bsdu gshegs rim pa rnams/ mkhas pas nye bar brtags te bya/ 'bras bu/ dkyil 'khor lha yis mchog ster la/ me yis 'dod pa'i don 'grub byed sogs kyis bshad do// sbyin sreg gis bsnyen pa'i kha skong*/ las gang yang myur bar byed pas kun gyi rjes su 'jug pa/ de yang me lha kun gyi zhal der bsreg pa de gsol ba yin/ des de gnyis mchog ster ro/ las/ dgos pa/ byed pa po dus gnas/ phyogs/ bya khyer/ thab de'i mdog de'i mtshan ma/ bud shing*/ mchod rdzas/ sreg rdzas/ de dag 'god tshul/ dgang gzar blugs/ chas gzhug

'dug stangs/ kha phyogs bdag bskyed/ mchod pa dang sreg rdzas byin brlab/ ku sha bkram pa/ me spar tshul/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed pa/ rang bzhin pa'i gnas nas spyan drang pa/ dam tshig pa la bstim pa mchod/ dgang blugs/ 'bul ba'i dus kyi khu tshur/ sngags tshig 'bul ba/ bstod pa me bsgyur ram lto bar ram dpang por 'jog pa gang rung ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha bskyed chog pra ngan na/ bzlog pa/ rdzas gnyis 'bul ba/ bstod pa/ 'dod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ slar 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ las gzhug sdud pa'i khyad par zhib mo phyed par bya'o// le'u bcu dgu pa'o/// / bzhi pa bstod pas 'grub pa ni/ zhu lan gyi/ nga yi ming ni nyi shu gcig /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang*// mi 'gyur g.yung drung dbang bskur te// zhes ngo bo bstan/ na mo nī lam sogs kyis so so bshad/ rdo rje gtum po'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di 'dzin pa sogs kyis phan yon bstan no// 'di'i mtshan re re lha sngags/ des bsgrubs pa'i thabs re yang rigs te/ mtshan brgyad gsang ba'i bdag po brgyad du bshad pa'i rigs pa'i 'phul 'ded las so// rgyas par mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sogs te sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i phyir gyis so// le'u nyi shu pa'o/// / gsum pa bshad zin mjug don bstan pa ni dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud 'di bshad pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ ji ltar gzung ba'i cho ga ji lta bu lags/ zhes zhus so// lan/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs// zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma// bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon// phyi ma'i dus su nga yi rgyud// gsang ba sku gsung thugs kyi gter// bla med rgyud rgyal rin chen 'di// byang chub sems ldan snying rje che// sogs kyis mtshan ldan la bshad par bya ba/

de las bzlog pa'i gang zag la// sogs kyis gsang zhing sba bar bya ba/ de bas gsang ba sku gsung thugs/ sogs kyis gces spras kyis ded dpon 'dod chen pos nor bu rin chen la bya ba lta bur bya'o// de'i dgos pa/ 'di dang bral bar ma gyur na// bsnyen pa de yin sgrub pa de/ bsgrub pa chen po de yin te// kun kyang de yin lha yang de/ bla ma de yin slob dpon kyang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun kyang*// de yin bskyed dang rdzogs pa ste// ma lus dbang yang de yin te// hril gyis bsgril na gcig chog rgyal po zhes bya'o// 'jig rten bya ba kun spangs nas// 'di la mchod par gyur na ni// tshogs gzhan ci yod/ tshogs thams cad 'dis rdzogs pas gzhan bsag tu med de rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chos kun tu gzung bar song bas so// de nas yum la bstod cing des mchod cing bstod de/ slar rdo rje'i lte bar thim pa dang 'khor rnams kyis rjes su yi rang ba dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis rgyud chen po 'di re zhig rdzogs par shes par bya'o// le'u nyer gcig pa'o/// / sprin 'dzin ngos kun bai ḍrūrya// byed la lhun po de bzhin du// ma lus nus pa can nyid du// gsang ba mngon par bstan 'dis so// zhes gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud cha tsam du bshad pa 'di chos 'di la lhag par bka' drin che ba rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi mgon pos rtsom 'os zhes snga mo nas bskul bar mdzad pa dang nye rkyen sngags 'chang kun dga' snying pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ shar kong po'i ljongs lta ba g.yung drung rdzings phyogs su mgo gtad lha gnya' khri btsan po'i pho brang 'ching bar stag rtse da lta rgyal rir grags pa'i zhol srib mo gnya' khri'i sgar du rdzogs par bsgrubs pa'i dge bas thams cad kyang mthu stobs gsang ba'i bdag po dang mnyam par gyur cig gu /maṅga laṃ//
